name: FINAL ens (submission 57532611)
rank: per-column percentile rank over the whole scored cohort: pandas.DataFrame.rank(axis=0, method='average', pct=True)

members.S6: Sixway: equal mean of 6 CoAtNet components (sixway_core.csv)
members.C6: H6 ConvNeXt-S, Core6-label arm, SWA of EMA epochs 14-16 (h6_core6_raw.csv)
members.VM: H6 ConvNeXt-S, VM-label arm, SWA of EMA epochs 14-16 (h6_vm_raw.csv)

s6_only_columns: columns whose weights are {S6: 1.0} keep the raw Sixway probability (no ranking)
